title: Stacked inventory
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns an Inventory class. `Inventory.new(maxStack: number, slots: number)`.
Each slot holds one item type, up to maxStack of it. Methods:
`:add(item: string, n: number): number` fills existing stacks of that item first, then empty slots, and returns how
many were added (the rest does not fit); `:remove(item: string, n: number): boolean` removes n if there are at least
n (a slot that becomes empty is free again) and returns true, otherwise changes nothing and returns false;
`:count(item: string): number`.
